Completing the Event Summary

Two ways in. One form. Here is what to fill in, and what fills itself in.

Three steps, every time

The form looks long, but most of it is already filled in before you arrive.

1

Open the summary

From your task list on the home page, or from Reports. Both land on the same form.

2

Fill in the pink

Tier of support, follow-ups, materials handed out, presenter notes. Nothing here can be calculated.

3

Save Summary

One green button at the bottom. Your name and the time are stamped on it.

Worth knowing: the numbers marked auto come from signups and the feedback survey. You can type over them if the real count was different — the system keeps both.

Way one: from your task list

Home page, Things To Do Today. The summary task appears on its own after the session.

Opens the form in place

Check the session date first

One event can have several sessions. Each one gets its own summary.

Pick the right session

Attendance is already counted

These four tiles read from signups and check-ins. Nothing to type.

Read-only — comes from signups

Attendance Totals — the pink sheet, on screen

The box is yours. The Auto figure beside it is what the system counted.

Reach, not attendance — never added in

Walk-ins go here

People who never signed up. Each one counts toward the attendance total.

Adds to attendance and to Contacts

Feedback Summary — a status report

Surveys sent, still pending, completed, and the response rate. It updates on its own.

Read-only

The pink form is yours

Tier of support and follow-up counts. Nobody else can supply these.

Set the tier
Follow-ups: parents and professionals

Materials: packed, and handed out

Manual entry — the feedback survey does not capture any of this.

Confirm the presenter
Blank row — type anything else you gave out

Comments, then save

The last line records who saved it and when.

Save Summary

Way two: through Reports

Use this when the task is gone, or the event was weeks ago.

Left menu
Narrow it down

Open the card, then Edit Summary

The detail panel is read-only. The yellow button opens the editable form.

Read-only view
Opens the same form

The short version

  • Two doors, one form. Your task list right after the event, or Reports any time after that.
  • Session date first. Everything below it changes with your selection.
  • Leave the auto numbers alone unless the real count was different — then type over them.
  • The pink section is yours. Tier of support, follow-ups, materials, comments. Blank means lost.
  • Dissemination Reach is not attendance. It is reported on its own.
  • Save Summary. If you did not save it, it did not happen.
